armyRules.name: Stoic Resilience
armyRules.flavor: The Legion is built to be the last thing standing, and has forgotten how to be the first to move.
benefits: A Model with this Special Rule adds 1 to its Cool Characteristic.
drawbacks: A Unit with this Special Rule cannot Rush, and subtracts 1 from the result of its Charge Rolls.

armyRules.name: Siege Engineers
armyRules.flavor: Imperial Fists gunners are taught to reduce a wall one stone at a time.
benefits: Enemy Models cannot make Cover Saves against Wounds caused by a Shooting Attack made by a Model with this Special Rule, if its Unit did not move during its Controlling Player's last Movement phase.
drawbacks: A Model with this Special Rule subtracts 1 from the result of its Hit Tests when it makes a Shooting Attack against a Flyer or against a Unit that Rushed during its Controlling Player's last Battle Turn.

armyRules.name: Wall Captains
armyRules.flavor: Dorn's officers hold ground by standing on it.
benefits: A Model with this Special Rule adds 1 to its Leadership Characteristic.
A friendly Unit that includes a Model with this Special Rule treats its Cool Characteristic as 7 if it would otherwise be lower.
drawbacks: A Model with this Special Rule subtracts 1 from its Movement Characteristic.

wargear.name: Bastion plate
wargear.summary: Extra ceramite slabs bolted over the plate of a man who will not be moved.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with Bastion plate adds 1 to its Toughness Characteristic and subtracts 1 from its Movement Characteristic.

wargear.name: Rampart standard
wargear.summary: A banner planted in the ground and defended to the last.
wargear.text: A Unit that includes a Model equipped with a Rampart standard has the Feel No Pain (6+) Special Rule.

wargear.name: Range-finder array
wargear.summary: A pintle-mounted auspex and ranging lasers, calibrated to the yard on a wall the crew has measured a hundred times.
wargear.text: A Unit that includes a Model equipped with a Range-finder array adds 1 to the Ballistic Skill Characteristic of every Model in it.

wargear.name: Pavise stakes
wargear.summary: Sharpened iron stakes driven into the ground before the line to break any charge.
wargear.text: A Unit that includes a Model equipped with Pavise stakes has the Anti-Charge Stakes Special Rule.

wargear.name: Praetorian seal
wargear.summary: A seal of Dorn's household, said to steady any Unit that sees it.
wargear.text: A Unit that includes a Model equipped with a Praetorian seal has the Unshaken Seal Special Rule.

wargear.name: Warden's targeter
wargear.summary: A rangemark projector that paints a wall for every gun behind it.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Warden's targeter has the Warden's Mark Special Rule.

wargear.name: Wall-breaker gauntlets
wargear.summary: Gauntlets built to tear the doors from fortress gates.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with Wall-breaker gauntlets has the Wall-Breaker's Grasp Special Rule.

wargear.name: Phalanx pennant
wargear.summary: A narrow pennant that tells each warrior where his neighbour stands.
wargear.text: A Unit that includes a Model equipped with a Phalanx pennant has the Closed Ranks Special Rule.

wargear.name: Fortress-lamp cluster
wargear.summary: A bank of floodlights and rangefinding lamps lit on the hull.
wargear.text: A Vehicle equipped with a Fortress-lamp cluster has the Lamp-Lit Targeting Special Rule.

wargear.name: Bastion plating
wargear.summary: Extra slabs of vault-grade armour welded across the glacis.
wargear.text: A Vehicle equipped with Bastion plating adds 1 to its Front Armour Value.

option.text: The Sergeant may take a siege-pattern weapon
The Templar Champion may take a Templar greatblade
Up to three models may wear Bastion plate
The unit may carry a Rampart standard
The unit may fit a Range-finder array
Praetorian regalia: may take up to two
The unit may plant Pavise stakes
The Sergeant may carry a Phalanx pennant
Up to two Legionaries may exchange their bolter for
Up to two Legionaries may exchange their bolter for
The Sergeant may take a Bastion sledge

modifiers.text: Bolter drill, rank on rank: +1 BS, -1 M.
Phalanx Warders stand as one: +1 LD, -1 I.
Templars close for the kill: +1 WS, -1 BS.
Dorn's own Huscarls strike hard and aim poorly: +1 A, -1 BS.
Siege-hardened hulls, slow to traverse: +1 HP, -1 BS.

rules.name: Shield Wall
rules.summary: Shoulder to shoulder, the line is a wall that does not bend.
rules.text: A Unit with this Special Rule that did not move during its last Movement phase has the Feel No Pain (6+) Special Rule against Wounds caused by Shooting Attacks, and automatically passes Cool Checks, until it next moves.

rules.name: Pre-sighted Arcs
rules.summary: The engineers have measured every yard.
rules.text: A Model with this Special Rule adds 1 to the result of its Hit Tests when it makes a Shooting Attack, provided its Unit did not move during its Controlling Player's current Movement phase.

rules.name: Sworn Crusaders
rules.summary: The oath is sworn, and the only direction left is forward.
rules.text: A Unit with this Special Rule adds 1 to the result of its Charge Rolls. If an enemy Unit is within 12" at the start of this Unit's Assault phase, it must declare a Charge against the closest one.

rules.name: Household Guard
rules.summary: The household is not frightened by anything it has not already faced.
rules.text: A Unit with this Special Rule is not affected by the Fear (X) Special Rule, cannot be given the Pinned Tactical Status, and adds 1 to its Cool Checks.

rules.name: Anti-Charge Stakes
rules.summary: Iron stakes driven into the earth turn every charge into a stumble.
rules.text: An enemy Unit that makes a Charge against a Unit with this Special Rule subtracts 1 from the result of its Charge Roll.

rules.name: Unshaken Seal
rules.summary: Dorn's seal says that the line will hold, and the line believes it.
rules.text: Once per battle, when a Unit that includes a Model with this Special Rule would be given the Pinned, Suppressed or Stunned Tactical Status, the Controlling Player may choose to ignore it.

rules.name: Warden's Mark
rules.summary: One target painted for every gun on the wall.
rules.text: At the start of each Shooting phase, the Controlling Player chooses one enemy Unit within 24" of a Model with this Special Rule. Until the end of that phase, Shooting Attacks made by friendly Imperial Fists Models against that Unit using a Weapon with an AP of 4 or worse have the Breaching (5+) Special Rule.

rules.name: Wall-Breaker's Grasp
rules.summary: The gate comes off its hinges, and so does whatever stands behind it.
rules.text: Melee Weapons used by a Model with this Special Rule have the Armourbane Special Rule when they are used against a Vehicle or a Fortification.

rules.name: Closed Ranks
rules.summary: Every man knows where his neighbour stands.
rules.text: A Unit with this Special Rule adds 1 to its Cool Checks while every Model in it is within 2" of its Sergeant.

rules.name: Lamp-Lit Targeting
rules.summary: Floodlit, ranged and measured: nothing hides from the hull.
rules.text: Cover Saves made against Wounds caused by a Shooting Attack from a Vehicle with this Special Rule have their Target Number increased by 1 (a 5+ Cover Save becomes 6+).

rules.name: Layered Plating
rules.summary: Plate laid on plate, and the hull remembers every hit.
rules.text: A Vehicle with this Special Rule adds 1 to its Front Armour Value.

rites.name: The Unmoved Phalanx
rites.flavor: Dorn set a line on the map and told his sons that the enemy would pay for every yard of it.
benefits: Phalanx Warder Squads may fill Troops slots and gain Line (2).
Phalanx Warders gain Shield Wall: if they did not move in their last Movement phase they gain Feel No Pain (6+) against Shooting Attacks and automatically pass Cool Checks.
limitations: At least one Phalanx Warder Squad is required.
No Fast Attack units, no Antigrav units and no Cavalry.

modifiers.text: The Unmoved Phalanx: Line (2), Shield Wall.

require.note: Bring at least one Phalanx Warder Squad.

rites.name: Fire from the Ramparts
rites.flavor: Every wall is a gun platform if the engineers have been given a week.
benefits: Tactical Support, Heavy Support and Veteran Heavy Support Squads may fill Troops slots.
Those squads and Rapier and Tarantula Batteries gain Pre-sighted Arcs: a Unit that did not move adds 1 to the Hit Tests of its Shooting Attacks.
limitations: At least one Techmarine is required.
No Heavy Assault or Fast Attack units, and at most one Transport or Heavy Transport.

modifiers.text: Fire from the Ramparts: Pre-sighted Arcs.

require.note: A Techmarine must oversee the works.

limit.note: At most one Transport or Heavy Transport.

rites.name: Oath of the Templars
rites.flavor: Before Dorn gave them a wall to defend, they were bred to carry the war into someone else's house.
benefits: Templar Brethren may fill Troops slots and gain Sworn Crusaders: they add 1 to their Charge Rolls.
Templar Brethren add 1 to their Initiative Characteristic on a Battle Turn in which they Charge.
limitations: Sigismund or a Praetor of any kind must lead the army.
At least two Templar Brethren squads are required.
Templar Brethren must declare a Charge against the closest enemy unit within 12" when able.
No Heavy Assault, Armour or Lord of War units.

modifiers.text: Oath of the Templars: Sworn Crusaders.

modifiers.condition: on a turn the unit charges

require.note: Bring at least two Templar Brethren squads.
Sigismund or a Praetor must lead the Templars.

rites.name: The Praetorian Retinue
rites.flavor: The Emperor's Huscarls follow no banner but Dorn's, and Dorn's banner is the Wall.
benefits: Huscarl Terminator Retinues may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).
Huscarls gain Household Guard: they are not affected by Fear (X), cannot be Pinned and add 1 to their Cool Checks.
limitations: At least one Huscarl Terminator Retinue is required.
No Cavalry, no Recon units and no Lord of War units.

modifiers.text: The Praetorian Retinue: Line (1), Household Guard.

require.note: Bring at least one Huscarl Terminator Retinue.
